tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sun zlog khyer bde rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/

sun zlog khyer bde mdor bsdus pa bya bar 'dod na/ mkha' 'gro'i dpal gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa mtheb kyu ci mang gis bskor ba la sha khrag 'bru sman zas sna'i phud kyis brgyan pa dang*/ gser skyems bcas bsham/ rtsa gsum gyi las gzhung gang rung bsrang zhing tshogs mchod bcas bya ba'am/ rang nyid gnyug ma'i lhar gsal ba'i ngang*/ mchod gtor rnams raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ na massarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgyas par spel la/ mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings nyid las/ khyab brdal ye shes bkod pa rang snang ba'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen po 'dir// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang*// ye shes las dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs// gdung bas 'bod la brtse ba'i g.yar dam gyis// rdzu 'phrul glog ltar myur ba'i shugs skyed la// tshur gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho dgyes par rol// oṃ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mchod gtor ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba dgyes bzhin du rol par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dzñā na karma lo ka dhā ka dhā ki nī shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra na massarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda pra tītstsha swā hā sa mchod/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs// ting 'dzin dgyes rgu'i 'dod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// sngon las 'phral rkyen sun ma zlog tu gsol// dbyings kyi yum chen lhan skyes dhā ki'i tshogs// 'od gsal rgyan gyi 'dod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog tu gsol// gang 'dul der snang zhing skyes pho nya'i tshogs// bde stong rol pa'i 'dod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog tu gsol// legs nyes stangs 'dzin phra men gnas nyul tshogs// longs spyod char 'beb 'dod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog tu gsol// rdo rje'i chos srung sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs// dgra bgegs sha khrag 'dod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// sa gsum 'byung po'i sun ma zlog tu gsol// dbyings las rang shar ye shes 'jig rten mgron// mthun rdzas 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs la rol// dgyes pa'i dpal skyed thugs rje'i shugs phyungs la// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol//

ces phrin las gsol// tshar grangs byed na/ mchod gtor kha gso zhing brlab/ gtor 'bul dang*/ mchod pa/ phrin las gsol ba bcas la grangs gzung*/ mthar phud dang gtor ma gshegs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyis// bdag cag yon mchod phyi nang gsang ba yi// bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// badzra muḥ sarba karma lo ka dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥ sa mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam la shis pa brjod pas bde legs su bya'o// zhes pa'ang mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs kyis tshig gi phreng ba nyung ngu la/ don gyi gnad gsang grub pa mchog gi zhal lung la sbyar te bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba dā su shrī yo bi dza yantu/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
